review: 701.68b-1: polarities were inverted for a prohibition rule (the rule's effect is that blight cannot be chosen); has_creature is now does_not_fire and no_creature fires.
701.68c-1: the decisions had A blight when the trigger was put on the stack; 'you may blight 1' is chosen on resolution, so the blight now happens as the trigger resolves.

skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated: no card in Forge's cardsfolder has an ability that triggers whenever a player blights (the blight cards only pay or perform it); 701.68a-1 and 701.68b-1 cover the blight action itself

scenarios.title: Blighting N puts N -1/-1 counters on a creature you control
decisions: A casts Cinder Strike (R, tapping Mountain) targeting Hill Giant. A chooses to pay the optional additional cost blight 1 and puts the -1/-1 counter on Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; Cinder Strike resolves.

variants.label: blight_paid
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has one -1/-1 counter and is 1/1. Cinder Strike was cast with its additional cost paid, deals 4 damage to Hill Giant, which moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: blight_not_paid
variants.delta: A does not pay the optional additional cost, so no creature is blighted.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has no counters and is 2/2. Cinder Strike deals 2 damage to Hill Giant, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

scenarios.title: A player with no creature cannot choose to blight
decisions: A tries to activate Evershrike's Gift from the graveyard ({1}{W}, blight 2), tapping both Plains and putting the two -1/-1 counters on Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: has_creature
variants.expected: The activation is legal: A controls a creature to blight. Grizzly Bears receives two -1/-1 counters and dies as a 0/0; Evershrike's Gift returns to A's hand when the ability resolves.

variants.label: no_creature
variants.delta: A controls no creature (Grizzly Bears is not on the battlefield).
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: A cannot pay blight 2. Evershrike's Gift stays in the graveyard and both Plains stay untapped.

scenarios.title: The blighted creature is the creature that received the -1/-1 counters

setup.notes: Grub is on the battlefield transformed, as Grub, Notorious Auntie (2/1 menace). Bears and Hill Giant do not attack.

decisions: A attacks player B with Grub only.
Grub's attack trigger goes on the stack; both players pass.
As the trigger resolves, A chooses to blight 1, putting the -1/-1 counter on Grizzly Bears, and the token is created tapped and attacking.

variants.label: blight_bears
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has one -1/-1 counter (1/1). A tapped, attacking token copy of Grizzly Bears (2/2, no counters) is created, with a sacrifice trigger at the beginning of the end step.

variants.label: blight_giant
variants.delta: A puts the -1/-1 counter on Hill Giant instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Hill Giant has one -1/-1 counter (2/2). The token is a tapped, attacking copy of Hill Giant (3/3, no counters); no token copies Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: no_blight
variants.expected: No creature receives a counter and no token is created.

scenarios.forge_notes: Grub, Notorious Auntie is the back face of Grub, Storied Matriarch; the setup needs Grub already transformed.
